data.name: Qaeen
data.gender_notes: Qaeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman with great power and authority, a ruler, a monarch. The name Qaeen carries the meaning “Queen” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashtun. Parents who choose Qaeen usually hope their child will grow to embody queen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, self-confidence, and leadership skills
data.etymology: Qaeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Queen.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaeen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: قين
in_arabic.meaning: القين هو الشخص الذي يملك المهارة في صنع الأشياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: القين هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ق-ي-ن' والذي يعني الصناعة والحرفة. في اللغة العربية، القين هو الشخص الذي يملك المهارة في صنع الأشياء، خاصةً في مجال الحرف اليدوية. ورد ذكر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة القصص، الآية 10، حيث وصف الله تعالى سيدنا موسى عليه السلام بأنه قين من آل فرعون.

in_urdu.name: قین
in_urdu.meaning: قین کا مطلب ہے ہنر مند شخص جو چیزیں بناتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کی روٹ 'ق-ی-ن' سے نکلا ہوا، قین کا نام ایک ہنر مند شخص کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو مختلف چیزوں کو بنانے میں مہارت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر ہاتھ سے بنائی جانے والی اشیاء میں۔ اس روٹ کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں قصص سورہ کی دسویں آیت میں آیا ہے، جہاں حضرت موسیٰ علیہ السلام کو آل فرعون کا ایک قین بتایا گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ैन
in_hindi.meaning: क़ैन का अर्थ है एक हुनरमंद व्यक्ति जो चीज़ें बनाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरबी मूल 'क़-य-न' से व्युत्पन्न, क़ैन नाम एक कुशल व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है जो विभिन्न वस्तुओं को बनाने में विशेषज्ञ होता है, खासकर हस्तनिर्मित वस्तुओं में। यह मूल कुरआन में सूरतुल क़सस, आयत 10 में उल्लेखित है, जहां हज़रत मूसा अलैहिस्सलाम को फ़िरआउन के घर का एक क़ैन बताया गया है।

in_pashto.name: قین
in_pashto.meaning: قین د هغو کسانو معنی دی چی په جوړولو کې مهارت لری
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ريښو 'ق-ي-ن' څخه اخیستل شوی، قین نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چي په بیلابیلو شیانو جوړولو کې مهارت لري، په ځانګړي ډول لاسي صنایعو کې. دا ريښه د قرآن کريم په قصص سورت، آیت 10 کې راغلې ده، چیرته چې حضرت موسی علیہ السلام د فرعون د کور يو قین بلل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Qaeen
in_english.meaning: Qaeen means a skilled person or craftsman who makes things
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ق-ي-ن', Qaeen refers to a skilled individual, especially one who excels in crafting or manufacturing items. This root is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Qasas, Verse 10, where Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) is described as a Qaeen from the household of Pharaoh. The name signifies expertise, craftsmanship, and industriousness, reflecting positively on the personality traits of the bearer, including creativity, diligence, and skillfulness.

pronunciation.hindi: क़ैन का उच्चारण कैसे होता है

data.cultural_impact: The name Qaeen in Islamic culture represents a woman of power, strength and leadership. Throughout history, there have been numerous Queen consorts and local rulers bearing this name. In some instances, it was used as a title for a reigning queen, while others lived up to the name in its figurative sense, as a woman of influence in society or within a household.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Qaeen lies in the belief that every woman possesses a unique power and influence that is not to be underestimated. The name Qaeen reminds us that each woman holds power within her, just as the term 'Queen' symbolizes the rule of a queen over her realm. This spiritual concept further emphasizes that every woman can rise to greatness and make a significant impact on her world. It is a call to women to embrace their inner strength, wisdom, and power. In essence, the name Qaeen invites every woman to discover and wield her divine feminine authority.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Queen" symbolizes A woman with great power and authority, a ruler, a monarch. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qaeen serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of queen.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Qaeen was the title of the wife of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Qaeen carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Qaeen was the title of the wife of the Prophet Muhammad, Aisha bint Abu Bakr, who is considered one of the most beloved wives of the Prophet.
